hni_signals: Very high public standing. 60th President of FOGSI (Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India) for 2021-22 - the 20th woman and first Telugu-speaking president, taking office 27 June 2021. Previously Vice President of FOGSI (from 2013) and Secretary of the Indian College of Obstetricians & Gynaecologists (ICOG) 2015-17; Organising Secretary of the 54th AICOG, Hyderabad 2011. Stood for the FIGO Trustee Board in the 2021 FIGO elections (FIGO published her candidate profile and CV). Qualifications MD, DNB, FICOG, FRCPI (Ireland), FRCOG (UK). Academic post as Professor of OBG at Deccan Medical College. Published as FOGSI President in the Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology of India (Springer). Runs her own branded professional website.
